readers: two independent Terra 6.1; reviewed all eight against source and native policy
local_policy: Payment conditional on eligibility, approval, mandatory fraud assessment, transfer/amount/recipient validity and tax check. A missing contract leaves duty to pay unknown. Flag/events in a later run scored from contemporaneous records.
notice: For a completed workflow require exactly one truthful vendor confirmation if paid or truthful status update otherwise.

0c22cbf6c9f3.specific_reason: Bank change has recorded callback and registered beneficiary. Check linkage and any unresolved anomaly; a change alone does not establish fraud.

26e82ce58f37.specific_reason: Permit fees outside registered equipment service and unsupported signed-budget claim warrant checking scope; actual configured new-vendor relaxed ceiling is 1000, below 2300. Policy leaves evidence sufficiency to investigator.

38f4c429958c.specific_reason: Amount below historical mean by more than 50%, and stand-alone technician hours need rental linkage. Assess before paying.

3d4fa367e1ed.specific_reason: Supplier pending. No payment until activated; notify even if no payment.

993d7ac72a07.specific_reason: High supplier risk, past duplicate and material price deviation require checking this specific invoice. A different past duplicate does not establish a duplicate here.

a37df75ee754.specific_reason: Standalone editing/color grading differs from equipment rental. Small new invoice qualifies for relaxed scrutiny on thin history; mismatch independently warrants clarification. Whether checks suffice is discretionary.

e36b820d7246.specific_reason: Registered bank change was verified in notes, amount well above paid historical mean. Evidence may support legitimate payment after assessment.

e7a7d298d950.specific_reason: Equipment matches profile, amount exceeds historical mean by more than 50%. Investigate variance and allow if satisfactorily resolved.
